mechanism_narrative: A current industrial production index above 100 (indicating expansion relative to 2017 base year) signals robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates labor market deterioration that depresses consumer confidence and spending, leading to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.1) signals a dual shock of weakening supply and monetary tightening, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 0.1, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, a consumer spending level (RSAFS) above 440,000 signals strong demand growth that accelerates corporate revenue and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 440000 and the regime is post-pandemic recovery, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A current consumer price index above 235.0 (indicating moderate inflation) signals stable price dynamics that support corporate profit margins and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1,000,000 units (annualized) signals robust residential construction and related economic activity, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% and a decline in employment level below 140,500 (thousands) signals a deteriorating labor market that depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 140500, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (indicating a slowdown in manufacturing output) signals weakening supply chain activity that reduces corporate production and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
